notes: {"info":["Hotfix on top of v1.4.9 — accepting/declining/cancelling a friend request from the Pending tab left the row visible until the user clicked Refresh manually, even though the action had actually gone through on RSI's side."],"features":["Contacts: race fix on friend-request mutations. RSI's accept/decline/cancel endpoints return 200 OK *before* the next identify response stops echoing the row (server-side replication lag). The popup now keeps a 30 s shield on every successfully-acted request id and filters it out of incoming/outgoing on every load, so the optimistic removal sticks until the server actually catches up. No more 'click Refresh for the row to leave'."]}

{"info":["Hotfix on top of v1.4.8 — Contacts → Pending tab listed every pending friend request as Incoming, even ones the user had sent themselves. Reproduced from a HAR dump of /api/spectrum/auth/identify: RSI dropped the `type` field from friend_requests entries, so the previous `r.type === 'out'` check always fell to the 'in' branch."],"features":["Contacts: friend-request direction is now derived from `requesting_member_id` (the actor who pressed Add friend) instead of the no-longer-populated `r.type` field. If I'm the requester, the entry is outgoing; otherwise it's incoming. The legacy `type` path is kept as a fallback in case RSI rolls the field back. Fix applies to both LIVE and PTU identify paths.","Cache: contacts:list cache version bumped (v2 → v3) so existing installs evict the previously misclassified bundle and refetch with the correct incoming/outgoing split on next popup open."]}

{"info":["Sync LIVE → PTU UX completion — full visibility into what the auto-retry loop is doing, a per-error retry button so you can re-attempt a single failed contact without rerunning the whole sync, and a recent-syncs history so you can see what you've done over the last few runs."],"features":["Contacts → Sync to PTU: 'Pending retries' card now shows when the last 12 h retry tick ran and what it accomplished (e.g. 'Last tick: 4h ago · 3 retried, 2 succeeded'). Persisted across SW sleeps so it's accurate even when the BG was inactive when you opened the popup.","Contacts → Sync to PTU: per-row retry button (↻) on entries with an Error status in the post-sync result table. Reattempts that single contact in-place — the row updates with the new outcome (added / pending / etc.), the totals card recomputes, and the persistent retry queue reconciles automatically. No need to click 'Sync now' again to retry one transient throttle / network blip.","Contacts → Sync to PTU: new 'Recent syncs' panel at the bottom of the Sync tab — bounded list of the last 10 runs (completed or cancelled) showing relative time, duration, total processed, and headline counts. Helps answer 'when did I last sync' and 'did the last run actually do anything'. Storage cost is trivial (~10 entries × ~150 bytes)."]}

{"info":["Sync LIVE → PTU now keeps trying on its own. Friends who don't have a PTU profile yet land in a pending queue and the extension re-attempts every 12 h for the next 7 days — they move to your PTU friend requests automatically as soon as their profile appears."],"features":["Contacts → Sync to PTU: notFound entries are now persisted to a retry queue and ticked by a 12 h alarm in the background. Resolved entries (added / alreadyFriend / alreadyPending on a later sync) auto-evict; entries past the 7-day window are dropped. No further user action needed after the initial sync.","Contacts → Sync tab: new amber 'Pending retries' card lists every entry currently in the queue with its avatar, handle, attempt count, and how long until the 7-day window expires. Per-row × button stops retries for that specific contact; 'Cancel all' wipes the queue.","Contacts → Sync to PTU: queue reconciliation runs at the end of every sync — if a previously notFound contact is now alreadyFriend / alreadyPending / added (e.g. you accepted their PTU request manually), they're removed from the queue automatically."]}

{"info":["Sync LIVE → PTU now shows live progress instead of just spinning. You can see exactly which contact is being processed, what already happened, and cancel mid-sync if needed."],"features":["Contacts → Sync to PTU: progress is streamed live to the popup over a long-lived port instead of returning at the end. New blue progress card shows the current phase (reading lists / classifying / adding), an X / Y counter, a real progress bar, and the handle currently being attempted. Pre-classified counts (already friend / already pending) show as sub-counters so you know they're already accounted for.","Contacts → Sync to PTU: live entry log expandable while the sync runs — every contact's outcome appears as soon as it's decided, newest at the top. No more waiting 30 seconds without feedback wondering if it's stuck.","Contacts → Sync to PTU: Cancel button. The sync finishes its current in-flight request (no way to abort RSI's HTTP cleanly) but stops starting new ones. The partial result still renders so you see what got done before stopping."]}

{"info":["Settings → Performance → Cache panel got a serious upgrade. You can now see what's actually in the cache, when it was fetched, when it expires, and how close you are to the storage quota."],"features":["Cache panel: column headers now label what each number means (Entries / Size / Last fetch / Next expiry). Hovering each header explains the column.","Cache panel: per-namespace 'Last fetch' (when the freshest entry was refreshed) and 'Next expiry' (when the soonest TTL flips). Both render as relative times with absolute timestamps in tooltips. At-a-glance answer to 'is my data fresh' and 'when will the next popup open hit the network'.","Cache panel: click the chevron next to any namespace to expand the row and see individual cache entries with their key, fetched-at, expires-in, and size. Expired entries render dimmed with an amber clock icon. Lazy-loaded so namespaces with hundreds of entries don't slow the panel down.","Cache panel: capability badges per namespace — `validated` (reads validate the shape against a Zod schema, shipped in 1.4.4) and `swr` (stale-while-revalidate, also 1.4.4). Lets you see at a glance which caches have the new safety nets.","Cache panel: storage quota indicator at the top of the section — progress bar showing used / 5 MB chrome.storage.local quota. Bar turns amber at 80%, rose at 95%. Most users sit at <10% so it's informational; useful when investigating 'why is my extension slow' on long-lived installs."]}

{"info":["Cache resilience pass — schema-validated reads catch shape mismatches before they crash a module, and stale-while-revalidate on long-TTL modules (Roadmap, Galactapedia A-Z) renders instant content even after the cache expires."],"features":["Cache: new cacheGetValidated(key, schema) helper takes a Zod shape and treats validation failure as a clean cache miss instead of returning malformed data. The 1.4.3 Contacts crash (poll-side writer dropped two fields, popup module read undefined.length) would have surfaced as a fresh refetch instead of a popup error with this in place. Migrated the four highest-risk multi-field caches: contacts:list, commlink:list, ships:list, stats:summary. Each declares its top-level required fields; future writers that regress get caught automatically.","Cache: new cacheGetWithStale(key) helper returns {value, isStale}. Roadmap (7-day TTL) and Galactapedia A-Z index (30-day TTL) now use it: when the cache is past its TTL, the popup gets the previous value instantly *and* a background refetch lands fresh data for the next read. The A-Z index is the biggest win — it costs 5-15 sequential GraphQL pages to rebuild, so a stale-served entry saves multiple seconds at popup open after the monthly TTL flips. Concurrent stale reads share one in-flight refetch via the existing dedupe helper. Response payloads gained an optional `isStale` flag the popup can use to render a subtle 'refreshing' hint."]}

{"info":["Hotfix on top of v1.4.2 — Contacts module crashed with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading length)' after a background poll tick. Caused by my own poll-side cache write in 1.4.0 only seeding `contacts` and dropping `incoming`/`outgoing`. The popup module read those as undefined and crashed on .length."],"features":["Contacts: writeContactsListCache now writes the full bundle (contacts + incoming + outgoing + fetchedAt) — same shape handleContactsList writes from the popup path. Cache version bumped (contacts:list v1→v2) so installs that already cached the broken shape get a clean wipe."]}

{"info":["Two small UX additions on top of the 1.4.0 + 1.4.1 cache + polling work — a status banner that surfaces RSI outages directly in the popup, and a 'Refresh all modules' button that hard-resets every cache + backoff in one click."],"features":["Status banner: when the BG circuit breaker (1.4.1) decides to skip a poll because RSI's published platform health says they're down or in maintenance, the popup now shows a thin amber banner under the header with the reason and a link to status.robertsspaceindustries.com. Disappears the moment the next successful poll clears the skip. Tracks the BG state live via the existing notify-state subscription — no extra fetch.","Settings → Performance → Cache → Refresh all modules: wipes every cache: entry, resets the per-module exponential backoff (so a degraded module gets a fresh chance instead of waiting out its 60-min cooldown), triggers an immediate poll, and reloads the popup so every Svelte module re-mounts against the fresh data. Heavier than per-module refresh buttons but useful when something feels broadly stale (e.g. RSI just came back from an outage and per-module TTLs haven't expired yet)."]}

{"info":["Polling intelligence — the background poll now respects RSI's own status feed and backs off when individual modules persistently fail. Stops wasting quota and battery when RSI is in maintenance, and stops hammering a flaky upstream when one feed is broken but others are fine. No user-visible UI change."],"features":["Status circuit breaker: at the top of every poll, the BG checks RSI's published platform health (status.robertsspaceindustries.com). When the Platform system is reported as 'down' or 'maintenance', the whole tick is skipped — no fetches, no errors. Reads the existing status:summary cache (popup users keep it fresh) and falls back to a single status-feed JSON fetch when stale. State exposes a `skippedReason` so future UI can surface it.","Per-module exponential backoff: when a collector fails repeatedly (Spectrum / Comm-Link / Patch Notes / Roadmap / Contacts / Release Notes — each tracked separately), its retry interval doubles up to a 60-min cap. 1st fail → next tick (10 min); 2nd → 20 min; 3rd → 40 min; 4th+ → 60 min. First success resets the streak. The other modules continue at normal cadence so a flaky Spectrum endpoint doesn't slow down Comm-Link polling. State persists across SW sleeps via the existing notify:state record."]}

{"info":["Cache + polling internals tightened — the popup now sees fresh data faster and the extension stops accumulating stale storage entries forever. No user-visible UI change; this is a perf + hygiene release."],"features":["Background poll → popup cache: when the badge poll fetches fresh Spectrum lobbies / notifications or Contacts list, the data now lands directly in the popup's module cache. Opening the matching tab right after a poll tick used to trigger a duplicate roundtrip; it's now a hot-cache hit.","Background poll → cache invalidation: for module data the poll can't write directly (Spectrum threads, Comm-Link, Patch Notes, Roadmap — different fetcher / paginated keys), the relevant cache entries get evicted whenever the poll detects new content. Next popup open refetches fresh instead of painting stale cache for the rest of TTL.","Cache hygiene: boot-time scan now prunes cache: entries whose TTL has already expired. Previously the lazy expiry in cacheGet only deleted entries that got re-read; paginated or abandoned keys (Comm-Link page 7 the user visited once last week) accumulated disk space indefinitely. Cheap on a clean install, ~one batch read on a long-lived install."]}

{"info":["Hotfix on top of v1.3.9 — three more bundle entries surfaced by mining the ship-matrix descriptions. Hangar HTML often consolidates these bundled child ships into the parent SKU, leaving them silently missing from the Ships tab."],"features":["Ships: Constellation Aquila (id 47) → Ursa rover (id 139). Source: ship-matrix description text — 'features ... an onboard Ursa rover for planetary exploration'.","Ships: Carrack w/C8X (id 204) → C8X Pisces Expedition (id 192). Source: SKU name itself ('w/C8X' suffix).","Ships: Carrack Expedition w/C8X (id 205) → C8X Pisces Expedition (id 192). Same source as 204. Note: the base Carrack (id 62) and base Carrack Expedition (id 206) without the 'w/C8X' suffix are intentionally NOT bundled — those SKUs don't include a Pisces."]}

{"info":["Hotfix on top of v1.3.8 — Constellation Phoenix and Phoenix Emerald packages bundle a Lynx rover and a P-72 Archimedes (regular or Emerald) according to the ship-matrix description, but RSI's hangar HTML rolls those into the parent Phoenix entry, so they were silently missing from the Ships tab."],"features":["Ships: new bundle inclusion table marks ships as actually OWNED (not just loaner) when their parent SKU is owned. Distinct from the existing loaners table — loaners are temporary chassis access, bundles are real ownership transitive across SKUs. Two seed entries for the Phoenix line, more can be added from the ship-matrix description text as users surface them.","Ships: when the bundled child has its own separate hangar entry (RSI sometimes splits Archimedes Emerald next to Phoenix Emerald), the existing hangar count wins; the bundle path only fills the gap when RSI consolidated the package."]}

{"info":["Hotfix on top of v1.3.7 — three ship-matching aliases reported by @superpenguintv via Discord on a v1.3.6 hangar dump showing 'A.T.L.S.', 'Ursa Rover Fortuna', and 'Dragonfly Star Kitten Edition' as Unknown."],"features":["Ships: A.T.L.S. (with dots) in the RSI hangar now matches the matrix entry ATLS (no dots — id 277). Both spellings resolve. Bonus: ATLS GEO (id 296) added too.","Ships: Ursa Rover Fortuna in the hangar now matches the matrix entry Ursa Fortuna (id 179) — RSI's hangar carries the 'Rover' qualifier on the Fortuna SKU but not on Ursa Medivac, so we needed an explicit alias for the long form.","Ships: Dragonfly Star Kitten Edition's catalog entry pointed at matrix id 1000 which doesn't exist any more (zombie id from an older RSI matrix). Updated to id 111 — it's a paint variant of the Yellowjacket, same chassis."]}

{"info":["DevTracker now mirrors what RSI shows on /community/devtracker — Patch Notes, Focus Testing, Feedback, Announcements, Ask The Devs, plus CIG replies inside community threads. Reported by @Hadjimels in #45. The previous tab only surfaced top-level threads in the Official + Concierge groups with the highlight_role_id===2 flag, which missed Patch Notes (those live mostly as replies, not new threads)."],"features":["DevTracker: source switched from a curated subset of forum channels to scraping RSI's actual /community/devtracker page. Same content RSI's site shows, including CIG replies in community threads with direct links to the exact reply.","DevTracker: each entry now carries the RSI-rendered category label (Patch Notes / Focus Testing / Feedback / Announcements / Ask The Devs) on the channel chip, with the channel colour pulled from identify when available."]}

{"info":["Hardening pass — preempts the whole class of Firefox MV2 bugs that have shipped twice already (1.3.0 popup→BG sendMessage, 1.3.5 UI scale chrome.tabs.*) and surfaces silent crashes in Settings → Diagnostics → Recent logs without forcing users to open DevTools."],"features":["Popup polyfill: globalThis.chrome is now shadowed with globalThis.browser at popup boot when the latter is present (Firefox / Waterfox / LibreWolf). Every chrome.* call in the popup — existing OR future, statically-imported OR lazy-loaded — now transparently routes through the Promise-native namespace. Removes the per-call wrappers that landed in 1.3.0 (messaging) and 1.3.5 (tabs); future API surfaces don't need a new wrapper. Chrome / Edge see no behavior change.","Error handler: window-level 'error' and 'unhandledrejection' listeners now pipe uncaught exceptions and unhandled promise rejections into the same log ring buffer that powers Settings → Diagnostics → Recent logs (and the 'Copy debug logs' button). Silent crashes that previously only surfaced in DevTools are now visible in the user's own log dump — most users won't think to open DevTools, so without this hook the only signal we got was 'it doesn't work' bug reports."]}

{"info":["Hotfix on top of v1.3.4 — Settings → UI scale +/- buttons silently did nothing on Firefox, and Ctrl+scroll while Settings was open threw a TypeError in the console. Reported by @Hadjimels in #44 with the verbatim error and a debug dump."],"features":["Settings: UI scale controls now work on Firefox / Waterfox / LibreWolf. Same root cause as the popup→BG sendMessage hang we fixed in 1.3.0 — chrome.tabs.getCurrent() / getZoom() / setZoom() are not reliably Promise-native on Firefox MV2. Calling them without a callback returned undefined synchronously: `await undefined` resolved to undefined, so the +/- buttons hit `if (!tab?.id) return` and silently bailed; the Ctrl+scroll listener's .then() threw because undefined.then is undefined. Fix: route through browser.tabs.* when available, same pattern as the messaging.ts polyfill."]}

{"info":["Hotfix on top of v1.3.3 — fixes the Sync LIVE → PTU result counts that were heavily inflating ERROR (and zeroing PENDING) on a second run. Reported by @DeusMaximus in #43 with a complete diagnosis: throttle responses, already-pending responses, and success responses were all being bucketed identically because the action helpers threw a plain Error and discarded the response code field."],"features":["Contacts: spectrum action helpers now throw a typed RsiSpectrumActionError that carries the server response code (ErrThrottleLimit, ErrExistingPendingFriendRequest, …). Both LIVE and PTU paths surface the code so callers can branch on machine-readable values instead of regexing the human msg.","Contacts → Sync LIVE → PTU: bucketing is now correct. Already-pending friend requests count as PENDING (was ERROR), per-IP throttles get one retry with a 1.5s backoff (was a hard ERROR), and the per-entry error message includes the code so it's clear what RSI rejected.","Contacts → Sync LIVE → PTU: dropped concurrency from 5 parallel workers to a sequential loop with 300ms between requests. The endpoint is throttled per-IP, so concurrency only burned quota without helping wall-clock. A 100-friend list still completes in well under a minute.","Contacts: friend_request entries are now correctly read whether RSI populates the singular r.member field (LIVE legacy shape) or the r.members[] array (PTU outgoing shape). Previously the PTU outgoing list was always empty so the sync's pre-classification couldn't catch already-pending entries — they all fell through to the send step and got rejected by the server. New helper picks the first non-self member from either field.","Contacts: autocomplete throttles now throw RsiSpectrumActionError instead of silently returning [] (which the sync then treated as 'user not found'). Other non-success codes still resolve to [] for backward compat with the live search box."]}

{"info":["Hotfix on top of v1.3.2 — fixes the 'still asks to sign in even though I am signed in' bug that broke the Edge Add-ons certification review and that several users hit on every browser. Thanks Dakota for the report and Microsoft's reviewer for the precise repro steps."],"features":["Auth: handleIdentity now sanity-checks the cached signed-out state against the live cookie before serving from cache. The cookie listener wipes auth:identity on sign-in/sign-out, but its async wipe could lose the race with a popup opening immediately after the cookie change — the storage read landed before the wipe completed and the popup painted a stale 'signed out' state for the next 30 minutes (TTL.identity). On a fresh install where the user signs in then opens the extension within a few ms, this was the worst-case path: extension was unusable until the user clicked Settings → Diagnostics → Force identity check. Cache now self-heals: if the cached entry says signed-out but a Rsi-Token cookie is sitting right there, we refetch instead of trusting the cache.","Popup: bumped default height from 520 to 530 px. One extra row of breathing space on first install / Reset; existing custom heights are preserved."]}

{"info":["Hotfix on top of v1.3.1 — Contacts → Find member search returned 'No citizens found' for every query because RSI wrapped the autocomplete response in a paginated envelope. Thanks @DeusMaximus for the report and the wire dump in #42."],"features":["Contacts: member autocomplete schema now reads members from data.members (the new envelope) instead of data directly. Both the LIVE search box and the 'Sync LIVE → PTU' member resolver are fixed.","Contacts: silent zod failures on the member-search path now log a warning with the parse issues to the background console. Future RSI shape drift (and we already have one on Community Hub and one here in two weeks) will surface immediately instead of looking like a UI bug."]}

{"info":["Hotfix on top of v1.3.0 — Community Hub tab refused to load on every install because RSI started returning null for the per-post account.live flag in their SSR payload. Thanks @WhisperDark for the report and screenshot."],"features":["Community Hub: zod schema for followedPostsFromSSR[].account.live now accepts null and coerces it to false at the extraction boundary. The whole tab (Home + Live + Discover + Gameplay + Tutorial + Events) was failing the parse because of this single field, even though Live was the only strip that actually consumed it."]}

{"info":["Spectrum got a complete overhaul — you can now read forums and DMs, vote, react, subscribe, bookmark, and navigate notifications without ever leaving the popup. Plus a critical Firefox / Waterfox fix that resurrected message passing between the popup and the background worker — every action was silently hanging on FF-MV2 since 1.2.x."],"features":["Spectrum — Forums tab: full browse tree (community switcher → channel groups → threads → thread detail with nested replies). Works for SC and every org community you've joined. Hot / New / Top / Active sort buttons all return results now (three of the four were sending the wrong wire vocabulary and silently returning empty).","Spectrum — Reading: thread bodies render with rich text (bold / italic / mentions / links), inline custom community emojis, media preview thumbnails on cards, and the official CIG gold tint on staff posts. Replies show member org / role badges next to the author name.","Spectrum — Vote: ▲ button on every thread and reply. Click to upvote, click again to remove your vote. Pressed state shows when you've voted.","Spectrum — React: full emoji picker on every thread, reply, AND DM message. Resolves both the per-community custom emojis (with image media) and ~250 standard Slack-style shortcodes (face_palm, clown_face, fire, etc.) including country flags via :fr: / :us: / :flag-jp: form. Click an existing chip to toggle your own reaction.","Spectrum — Subscribe: bell button on the channel header (watch every new thread) and on the thread detail (watch every new reply). Notifications fire to the popup's badge once activity hits.","Spectrum — Bookmarks: the thread detail's star button works, and you can now bookmark an entire forum channel from its header. Click any item in the Bookmarks tab to drill into it inside the popup.","Spectrum — Notifications: click a notif to mark it read AND navigate straight to the thread / lobby it points to (in-popup, no new tab). Hover-revealed × button dismisses individual notifs; the existing Mark all read sweeps the rest.","Spectrum — DMs: read-only chat history with 30s auto-poll, member badges, custom emoji rendering, and the same react / picker UX as forums.","Spectrum — In-popup navigation: clicking a card in DevTracker / Trending / Bookmarks / Notifications now drills into Forums or DMs inside the popup instead of opening a new RSI tab. Ctrl/Cmd/Shift/middle-click still opens externally for users who want a browser tab.","Spectrum — Forum search: ⌘K-style search box across thread titles in the current channel.","Community Hub: new Home tab with four strips — Live streams, Trending, Gameplay, Tutorial — so you don't have to flip through tabs to scan what's new.","Firefox MV2: popup → background sendMessage was returning undefined immediately on Firefox because chrome.runtime.sendMessage there isn't reliably Promise-native. Switched to browser.runtime.sendMessage when the namespace is available — every Spectrum / notify / module-fetch action now works on FF / Waterfox / LibreWolf instead of throwing 'No response from background worker'.","Notify poll: stopped spamming three RsiNotAuthenticatedError warnings per tick when the rsi_token cookie was still present locally but the server had already invalidated the session. The error was technically real but cosmetic — the next identity refresh corrects state, no value in shouting about it three times.","Org badges in Spectrum: badge icon URLs come back from the API as relative paths (/media/...). Now absolutified once at the extraction boundary so org logos actually render in the popup instead of broken-image glyphs.","Bookmarks: switched from the v2 endpoint (which required CSRF priming and could fail when no RSI tab was open) to the legacy v1 path. No user-visible change except: bookmark add / remove now works regardless of whether you have robertsspaceindustries.com open elsewhere."]}

{"info":["Tiny hotfix on top of v1.2.1 fixing a 404 on every Community Hub post link."],"features":["Community Hub: clicking a post in the Discover / Gameplay / Tutorial tabs no longer 404s. RSI collapsed the per-user post routes during their late-2025 hub rework, so /community-hub/user/{nickname}/post/{slug} stopped resolving in favour of /community-hub/post/{slug}-{uid}. The Live and Events tabs were already on the new format and were unaffected."]}

{"info":["Maintenance hotfix on top of v1.2.0 — three small but visible fixes from the first week of reports."],"features":["Firefox / Waterfox: fixed a crash in the toolbar-badge code that prevented unread counts (Comm-Link, Patch Notes, Status alerts) from updating on Firefox-MV2 builds. The popup itself was unaffected — only the numeric badge on the extension icon. Thanks @ravensrook for the report.","Patch Notes: removed the LIVE / PTU / EPTU / TECH-PREVIEW channel filter. CIG only publishes LIVE patches as Comm-Links these days so the other three tabs were permanently empty and confusing. Channel detection still runs per-card so the coloured badges keep telling you what kind of build each note covers. Thanks Dakota for the heads-up.","Release Notes module: fixed the date displayed next to each v1.x entry — six versions had stale placeholder timestamps stuck in the future (v1.2.0 was showing 3 May when it actually shipped 25 Apr). All entries now use the real git-tag dates."]}

{"info":["User-experience round driven by the post-1.1.x community feedback — popup is now resizable, the Settings module reorganised into three tabs, and a brand-new Support module collects bug-report flows, FAQ, and links in one place. Plus a quiet but important fix that finally surfaces every legacy referral and subscriber pledge in your Owned ships list."],"features":["Settings → Appearance → Popup size: two sliders to pick the popup window dimensions between 360×400 and 790×590, applied on slider release so the popup doesn't reflow under your cursor mid-drag. Defaults to the previous 760×520, and there's a Reset button.","Settings → Appearance → UI scale: ±/Reset controls that wrap your browser's native per-tab zoom (Ctrl + / Ctrl − / Ctrl-scroll) for tab mode, with browser-managed per-site persistence. The section is disabled in popup mode with a one-click shortcut to open the extension in a tab.","Tab mode: the sidebar now breathes more — wider rail, larger icons, more spacing between modules. Popup mode is unchanged because it has to fit 14 modules in a tight height budget.","Settings module reorganised into three top-level tabs (Appearance, Performance, Diagnostics) so you stop scrolling past unrelated cards to find the one you want.","New Support module in the sidebar: GitHub repo + pre-filled bug-report URL + Discord invite, clipboard shortcuts for Discord templates and hangar dumps, FAQ covering the questions most users ask, and an About card with the version and links to the privacy policy + Release Notes.","Ships: legacy referral and subscriber pledges that have no product-type tag on RSI's side (e.g. \"Surf and Turf\" containing a PTV, \"Gladius and Gold\" containing an F7A Hornet Mk II) now scrape correctly. Your Owned count finally matches what's in the RSI hangar end-to-end.","Ships: legacy pledges missing from RSI's CCU catalogue (rare older items) are now correctly marked as Owned in the Ships grid based on the hangar match alone, instead of being silently hidden when CCU didn't list them.","Roadmap: more empty / zombie release entries filtered out (cosmetic carry-over from the 1.1.1 work)."]}

{"info":["Quick follow-up to v1.1.1 closing three more hangar-detection bugs reported within an hour of release — thanks @DAVosselman for the debug dumps."],"features":["Ships: legacy pledges with no server-side product-type classification are now scanned properly. This was the last gap — some older referral-ladder rewards and subscriber bundles (e.g. 'Surf and Turf' containing a PTV, 'Gladius and Gold' containing an F7A Hornet Mk II) only appeared under the 'All' view of the RSI hangar and were silently dropped by the v1.1.1 scraper. Your Owned count should now match what the RSI website shows.","Ships: alias added for 'Genesis Starliner' — the matrix only calls it 'Genesis' so the exact-name lookup was failing.","Ships: stray trailing whitespace on RSI matrix names (observed on the C8X Pisces Expedition entry) no longer defeats name matching."]}

{"info":["Maintenance release with targeted fixes from the first round of community feedback on v1.1.0 — thanks to @DAVosselman, @DeusMaximus, Etyx and Kamille for the reports."],"features":["Ships module: ships included in game-package pledges are now detected — previously the hangar scraper skipped any package whose first item happened to be an Insurance or Digital Download row, silently hiding every ship the package contained. If your owned count looks bigger than before, that's why.","Ships module: the 'Copy hangar dump' button in the header copies a Markdown snapshot of your hangar (matched + unknown) to the clipboard — makes it trivial to report detection issues without typing every row by hand.","Ships module: paints, components, multi-tools, tractor beams, subscriber flair and similar non-ship pledge items no longer appear as 'unknown ships'. The hangar scrape now filters server-side by product type, so only standalone-ship and game-package pledges are ever considered.","Ships module: ground vehicles tagged as 'Vehicle' in the hangar are accepted alongside those tagged 'Ship', fixing some older PTV / Cyclone pledges that were silently dropped.","Roadmap module: patches that are live on the game (4.4 / 4.5 / 4.6 / 4.7 and onward) now correctly appear under 'Released' instead of 'Upcoming'.
